title: Ordinary coefficient exchange square
statement: Fix l,E,o,a, an arbitrary base B, input family X and ordinary integral inputs K. For any commutative square k:U→V, r:U→W, p:V→Z, i:W→Z with r,p proper and e an expression on V, the ordinary reduction of P_i S_p e followed by system properExchange equals the reduction of the ringed exchange mate followed by the ordinary reduction of S_r P_k e.

source.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, whose coefficient comparisons are proved in lem-fix-operation-reduction; coherence inherited from individual maps.

proof.text: Use the proved private properPullCoeff and matePastingNaturalSquare helpers from IntegralOrdinaryCompactificationExchangeSquare. The first obtains the forward pullback boundary from pull_square_nat, and the second transposes it through the proper adjunctions and inserts an arbitrary coefficient arrow by naturality. Specialize this generic identity directly to the ringed interpretation and ordinaryReduction of e. The endpoints are definitionally the two ordinary expression recursions. Neither ordinaryBasicSquare nor ordinaryCompactificationExchangeSquare is used.

proof_origin.place: C7: direct mate-pasting and naturality proof replacing the circular call to ordinaryBasicSquare; no assumption on the compactification-exchange theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryExchangeSquare
    (o : Operations l E) (a : AmbientModels l E o)
    {B : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} {X : I → Over B}
    (K : ∀ i, Integral l E (X i).left) :
    ∀ {U V W Z : Over B}
      (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W) (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z)
      (hr : IsProper r.left) (hp : IsProper p.left)
      (w : k.left ≫ p.left = r.left ≫ i.left) (e : Expression B I X V),
      (Expression.pull i (.push p hp e)).ordinaryReduction l E o a K ≫
        (properExchange l E o a.compositors k.left r.left p.left i.left w).app
          (e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) =
      (calculus l E W.left).reduction.map
          ((mateEquiv (ringedAdj l E p.left) (ringedAdj l E r.left)
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
              (ringedSquare l E k.left r.left p.left i.left w).hom)).natTrans.app
                (e.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)) ≫
        (Expression.push r hr (.pull k e)).ordinaryReduction l E o a K
